description: Nine ODI World Cup semi-finals. Two finals. Five T20 World Cup semi-finals and now a second final on Sunday. New Zealand’s record in big-ticket tournaments is anything but accidental, yet they continue to be casually described as cricket’s perennial dark horses.
title: Perennial dark horses, really? Why world keeps forgetting NZ’s World Cup pedigree

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has inaugurated and laid the foundation stone for infrastructure projects worth Rs 33,500 crore in Delhi. This includes two new Delhi Metro corridors, totaling over Rs 18,300 crore, aimed at enhancing public transport and connectivity. The event also features the foundation stone laying for three new metro routes under Phase V-A and GPRA redevelopment projects.
title: PM Modi to inaugurate two new Delhi Metro corridors: Key routes and how they will help commuters

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Droupadi Murmu extended heartfelt greetings on International Women's Day, celebrating 'Nari Shakti's' pivotal role in India's progress. Both leaders lauded women's determination, creativity, and zeal, emphasizing their empowerment as central to national development and the creation of an inclusive, prosperous society where every woman can achieve her full potential.
title: President Murmu, PM Modi hail 'nari shakti' on International Women's Day

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: A political storm erupted after West Bengal's last-minute venue change for the International Santhal Conclave, drawing public displeasure from President Murmu. She questioned the reasoning and highlighted the community's struggle for recognition, sparking a fierce exchange between the TMC and BJP over alleged politicization of tribal issues and disrespect to the President's office.
title: President Murmu unhappy over venue shift, PM calls it 'insult'; Mamata hits back — Santal row

author: etimes.in
description: During a lively segment on The Great Indian Kapil Show, Ravi Kishan cheekily responded to Manoj Tiwari's boast about introducing him to the political arena. With a glint in his eye, Kishan declared that he was the true mentor for both Tiwari and Nirahua, having taught them the very essentials like walking, speaking, and even crafting impactful lines.
title: Ravi Kishan reacts to Manoj Tiwari’s claim about bringing him into politics

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Global software stocks experienced an $830 billion wipeout following the launch of AI plugins, sparking fears of obsolescence. However, tech leaders like TCS CEO K Krithivasan push back, arguing complex enterprise systems won't be replaced by chatbots. Wall Street is repricing the sector, questioning if AI will hollow out or enhance software companies.
title: TCS CEO says AI fears wiping billions off markets are a phase of 'worry and anxiety'

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: The UFC has announced its historic UFC White House 2026 event, headlined by Ilia Topuria vs. Justin Gaethje for the undisputed lightweight championship. Taking place on June 14, 2026, on the White House South Lawn, the Freedom 250 card also features Alex Pereira vs. Ciryl Gane for the interim heavyweight title and several other high-profile bouts.
title: UFC White House 2026 Fight: Ilia Topuria vs. Justin Gaethje to headline Freedom 250

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Watch: America’s C-RAM system in action intercepting rockets and fired at US embassy in Iraq

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: New Zealand bowler Brett Randell made history by becoming the first player in 254 years of first-class cricket to take five wickets in five consecutive deliveries. Playing for Central Districts against Northern Districts, he finished with 7/25, helping bowl out ND for 82 after CD’s 373 in the Plunket Shield match.
title: Watch: First cricketer in 254 years! Bowler sets jaw-dropping world record

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: MS Dhoni arrived in Ahmedabad ahead of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 final between India and New Zealand national cricket team at Narendra Modi Stadium. Dhoni had earlier watched India’s semi-final win over England in Mumbai. Led by Suryakumar Yadav, India aim to defend their title, while New Zealand chase their maiden T20 World Cup crown.
title: Watch: MS Dhoni arrives in Ahmedabad for T20 World Cup final

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Finn Allen transformed from a middle-order batter into New Zealand’s explosive T20 opener after Wellington coach Glenn Pocknall promoted him to open in 2020. Recognising his power and attacking potential, Pocknall nurtured Allen’s aggressive style through challenging training. Allen later proved the decision right with record-breaking performances, including a 33-ball T20 World Cup century and a 151-run MLC blitz.
title: Allen: 'Bat at No.1' instruction, MLC carnage and making of Kiwi destroyer

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: Silence and crowd noise were back in discussion ahead of Sunday's final but India captain Suryakumar Yadav chose to downplay the chatter. He acknowledged the challenges, pressure and excitement a final brings, and his message to the team was simple: be courageous.
title: T20 World Cup 2026: Ahmedabad, the final, and the ghost of November 19 past

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Motovlogger Anurag Dobhal, known as UK07 Rider, livestreamed his SUV crashing at high speed on the Delhi-Meerut Expressway. Visibly distressed and speaking of loneliness, he steered his vehicle into the highway divider.  Dobhal, who had spoken of personal and family disputes, sustained injuries and fractures but is stable.
title: '80,000 watching live': Watch moment YouTuber crashes Fortuner on Delhi–Meerut Expressway

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: President Trump declared the US has eliminated Iran's entire leadership, describing it as removing a "cancer." He asserted US forces have decimated Iran's navy, air force, and missile capabilities, claiming victory in the ongoing conflict. Trump denied US responsibility for a school bombing, blaming Iran's inaccuracy.
title: Is US responsible for Iran school bombing that killed 160? What Trump said

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Israeli forces struck fuel storage complexes in Tehran and Karaj, causing large explosions and fires. The military stated these sites were used for Iran's armed forces, calling it a significant strike to dismantle military infrastructure. Iran's Revolutionary Guards Corps announced retaliatory attacks on Israel.
title: Watch: Israel strikes several oil depots in Iran; towering smoke, massive blaze light up skyline

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A joint US-Israeli attack killed Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, fulfilling President Trump's "regime change" calls. However, a classified intelligence report suggests this is unlikely to topple the entrenched clerical and military establishment, even with a large-scale assault. Analysts concluded Iran's system would likely continue functioning due to established continuity procedures.
title: Khamenei gone but regime change in Iran 'unlikely', US intelligence warns — report

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Ranveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar 2' is generating immense buzz, with preview tickets fetching an astonishing Rs 2500. Advance sales have already surpassed 40,000 tickets, raking in approximately Rs 5 crore. The film's release across five languages on March 19 is anticipated to boost its performance, following the massive success of its predecessor.
title: Dhurandhar 2’ update: Preview tickets soar and reach Rs 2400 sales run rampant

author: ADVITYA BAHL
description: A Delhi driver was arrested for allegedly strangling a woman to death with her scarf following a financial dispute. The victim, Kavita, met the driver, Vicky Mathur, and offered him money to marry her, but he refused. Mathur then allegedly strangled her, stole her cash, and dumped her body in Noida.
title: Man held for strangling woman over marriage, money dispute; body dumped on Noida service road

author: TOI TRENDING DESK
description: International Women's Day prompts reflection on the vital roles women play, often quietly.  The article highlights the significance of acknowledging their strength, effort, and presence.  It offers a collection of messages, wishes, and quotes to help express appreciation for the women who enrich our lives, encouraging a pause to recognize their impact.
title: Happy International Women's Day: 75+ messages, greetings, wishes and quotes

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: A viral social media post criticizing Taylor Swift has sparked debate online, referencing her past relationship with Joe Alwyn and mentioning Travis Kelce. The post accuses Swift of belittling Alwyn’s struggles and mocks her current relationship. While the comments spread quickly online, they reflect one user’s opinion rather than verified claims about the singer.
title: 'Spoiled narcissist': Taylor Swift faces online criticism about Joe Alwyn

author: TNN
description: Two college friends, aged 18 and 20, were found dead in a temple washroom in Surat after allegedly injecting themselves with anesthetic drugs. Police discovered drug vials and syringes, along with mobile phone data indicating searches for suicide methods. The girls had left for college and did not return home.
title: 'Used AI to find ways': Two college friends die by suicide inside Gujarat temple washroom

author: TNN
description: A morning dog walk in Bengaluru's Varthur escalated into a physical clash between residents at Brigade Cornerstone Utopia. A dispute over a pet owner using a designated exercise area led to accusations of abuse, phone snatching, and assault. Police have registered cross-complaints and are investigating the incident.
title: Watch: Bengaluru apartment residents come to blows over dog walk

author: KRISHNA CHAUDHARY
description: A shocking incident unfolded in Moradabad where a 25-year-old engineer allegedly murdered his twin sister, stabbing her multiple times, and attacked their mother. The accused, reportedly stressed over a breakup, lashed out when his sister tried to console him during an argument. Neighbours alerted police after hearing screams, leading to the swift arrest of the engineer.
title: 'Stabbed 40 times': 25-year-old engineer kills twin sister, attacks mother after argument
